items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: he had a fellow named Eichelberg on the saxophone... and I said I would like to join this band They needed a second trumpet and said get right in there.

ctx.x: Now, from U Street, from 11th and U to 22nd and E, first you got to go all the way to 11th, you got 11 blocks to go, long blocks, Washington blocks to go and then you got to come down from U to E Street, so I made that -- I never had any desire to try to gamble, never, so I'm happy about that. I am extremely happy.

So all right, then I was at a little dumpy theatre, it's called the Mid-City Theatre, and they had a jazz band in there and they had a fellow named King Swayzee; he come from Arkansas and he looked like one of them -- not Cherokee, like a Pawnee Indian, so King Swayzee, he was in this show and he had a fellow named Eichelberg on the saxophone, had a guy on trombone,
and I said I would like to join this band They needed a second trumpet and said get right in there.
